feeding_claim.verbatim: We don't feed the beef cattle any grains - no corn, no soybeans, no milo - cattle are herbivores

resold_note: The farm store also sells honey, raw milk cheeses, yogurt, beans and grains, and the site does not say these are made from the farm's own animals or crops.
notes: Family farm founded by Cliff McConville, with its farm store at Brunner Farm on Route 31 in Dundee, northwest of Chicago, and a second farm near Elkhorn, Wisconsin. Checked the our farm, ways to shop and FAQ pages. The beef cattle get no grain, only pasture and hay in winter. Pigs are on pasture with a certified organic grain supplement, and chickens and laying hens are on pasture with supplemental feed. The farm milks its own Guernsey cows and sells A2A2 raw milk for pickup; raw milk is legal only in some states. The farm store is open daily, online orders can be picked up curbside, and frozen meat ships by FedEx Ground to IL, WI, MI, IN and IA (no milk, eggs or orders over 50 pounds). Half and whole beef and hogs are sold by hanging weight with processing paid to the processor. A pickup point at the Elkhorn farm is listed as coming soon.
